description: Pro. Map a site into page types. Crawls the site from `url` (same origin only, up to 40 pages, 4 requests at a time, or only the `paths` you list), uses sitemap.xml to find pages, and obeys robots.txt for the user agent ATPDesigners. Reads static HTML only. The result opens with coverage: pages read of pages found, which were skipped or truncated, and requests used. Returns page-type groups (by URL pattern and template markers) with counts found and read, depth, orphan hints from sitemap and link comparison, and a pages.md style table with one verified URL per type that other audits can take as input.

maxPages.description: Optional lower page cap. The hard cap is 40 pages.

paths.description: Optional list of same-origin paths such as /about. When given, only these pages are read and links are not followed.

sitemap.description: Use sitemap.xml to find pages. Default true.

url.description: Home page or any page on the site. The crawl stays on this origin.
